passive.name: At the End of the Beast-Paths
passive.text: Gain **12/15/18/21/24%** All Elemental DMG Bonus. Obtain the Tireless Hunt effect after hitting an opponent with a Charged Attack. This effect increases Charged Attack DMG by **160/200/240/280/320%** of Elemental Mastery. This effect will be removed after 12 Charged Attacks or 10s. Only 1 instance of Tireless Hunt can be gained every 12s.

passive.name: The Cleansing Form
passive.text: HP is increased by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When there are opponents nearby, the DMG dealt by the wielder of this weapon is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%**. This will take effect whether the character is on-field or not.

passive.name: Echoing Ballad
passive.text: Increases CRIT DMG by **20/25/30/35/40%**. Hits have a **60/70/80/90/100%** chance to inflict a small AoE attack, dealing 125% Physical ATK DMG. Can only occur once every **4/3.5/3/2.5/2**s.

passive.name: The Way of Sunfire
passive.text: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing **60/75/90/105/120%** ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take **28/35/42/49/56%** more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.

substatLine: CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG > ATK% > Elemental Mastery
skillPriority: Normal Attack > Elemental Burst > Elemental Skill

entries.name: Khanda Barrier-Buster
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

**Charged Attack**
Performs a more precise **Aimed Shot** with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Dendro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
·Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of flora that deals **Dendro DMG**.
·Charge Level 2: Fires off a Wreath Arrow that deals **Dendro DMG**. Upon hit, the Wreath Arrow will create 4 Clusterbloom Arrows that will track nearby opponents automatically and deal **Dendro DMG**.

**Plunging Attack**
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Vijnana-Phala Mine
entries.text:
Tighnari throws a Vijnana Stormheart ahead that deals **AoE Dendro DMG**, creating a Vijnana-Khanda Field that creates mysterious illusions that taunt opponents and draw their fire.
Additionally, Tighnari gains the Vijnana Suffusion effect, which will decrease the Wreath Arrow's charging time by 2.4s. This effect will dissipate once the skill duration ends or after Tighnari has fired 3 Wreath Arrows.

"If seeds wither apart from the soil, they will remain a single seed. But if returned to the soil, they shall multiply ten-million fold."

entries.name: Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft
entries.text:
Combines the power of all seeds to fire 6 Tanglevine Shafts that can track opponents and deal **Dendro DMG**.
After they hit, the Tanglevine Shafts will create a secondary wave of Tanglevine Shafts that can also track nearby opponents and deal **Dendro DMG** on hit.

"Do not seek to escape so easily. The vines grow and regrow ever on. Things might get dicey if you don't clear every last one of them out."

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries.text: After Tighnari fires a **Wreath Arrow**, his Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for 4s.

entries.name: Scholarly Blade
entries.text:
For every point of Elemental Mastery Tighnari possesses, his Charged Attack and **Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft** DMG are increased by 0.06%.
The maximum DMG Bonus obtainable this way is 60%.

entries.name: Encyclopedic Knowledge
entries.text: Displays the location of nearby **resources unique to Sumeru** on the mini-map.

entries.name: Beginnings Determined at the Roots
entries.text: Tighnari's Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 15%.

entries.name: Origins Known From the Stem
entries.text:
When there are opponents within the Vijnana-Khanda Field created by **Vijnana-Phala Mine**, Tighnari gains 20% **Dendro DMG Bonus**.
The effect will last up to 6s if the field's duration ends or if it no longer has opponents within it.

entries.name: Fortunes Read Amongst the Branches
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves
entries.text: When **Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft** is unleashed, all nearby party members gain 60 Elemental Mastery for 8s. If the Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers a Burning, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Quicken, or Spread reaction, their Elemental Mastery will be further increased by 60. This latter case will also refresh the buff state's duration.

entries.name: Comprehension Amidst the Flowers
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Vijnana-Phala Mine** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Karma Adjudged From the Leaden Fruit
entries.text: **Wreath Arrow**'s charging time is decreased by 0.9s, and will produce 1 additional Clusterbloom Arrow upon hit. This arrow deals 150% of Tighnari's ATK as DMG.
